benchmark: two mutually exclusive independently stateful streaming Q15 db2 DWT contexts; A one level, B two levels; 2:1 decimation

budget.extension_policy: additional clean starts require a separately recorded extension and must not delay submission packaging

gate_ladder: corners: directed impulse/reset/context-switch/extreme/pending-level-2 and mutant-4 truncation-slice cases
structure: <= 8 normalized multiplication operators (stat -json num_cells_by_type, mul/macc)
area: unweighted generic Yosys cell count strictly below 60% of the independently synthesized two-reference sum
holdout: controller-only synthesized generic netlist, 1202 cycles, seed 0x7D17BEEF, Icarus + Yosys simcells; generic failure note only
acceptance: all six gates pass on the controller-hashed candidate

thresholds.pilot_origin: disclosed model-free pilot calibration; final counts above replace pilot values and reproduce

controls.naive_wrapper_negative: must fail structure and area, pass functional

hidden_assets.positive_control_rtl: held in controller driver; never in prompts
hidden_assets.policy: model prompts contain only references, contract, and public gate feedback

isolation: implementer is a stateless reply-mode text call with no filesystem/tool access; adviser runs with write tools denied; controller kills model processes before holdout evaluation
stop_conditions: first failed semantic gate for a candidate
protected input hash or config fingerprint change
hidden assets exposed to a model process
control or mutation behavior deviates from the frozen selftest
operator determines remaining time threatens submission audit
claim_language: On a frozen streaming Q15 db2 benchmark containing mutually exclusive, independently stateful one- and two-level decomposition contexts, ChiaMerge produced (or did not produce) a candidate that passed directed and randomized bit-exact RTL checks, a controller-only synthesized-netlist holdout, and frozen structural gates. Any accepted candidate is reported with its unweighted generic Yosys cell count, never as mapped area; no physical, timing, power, exhaustive-proof, or signal-quality claim is made.
operator_confirmation_required: campaign run cannot delay final submission audit
run venue (VM per FIR precedent, or local with GEMINI_API_KEY exported)
refreeze_note: Re-frozen 2026-09-17 before the first model call: the launch-gate selftest on the VM caught an OSS-derived simcells path bug in the driver (parents[1] vs parents[0]); the driver was fixed and both the local and VM selftests pass with the frozen hash. No model call had occurred.
